scope: Snapshot of evidence-required rows only; proposed probe protocols, not runnable tests or fresh semantic verification of every manifest note. Exceptions and best-effort residual gaps remain outside this row inventory. No new compatibility credit.

publication-removal.dependency: Matching base/target client captures and complete addon/load-phase inventory. Simulator-only runs cannot establish native absence.
publication-removal.next_probe: Query the exact old symbol before and after explicit LoD loads on both versions; record failed/skipped loads and any replacement separately. For CVars query value/default and spelling; for removed fields exercise their producer. Do not infer absence from a missing declaration.

event-producer.dependency: An identified producer and a controllable transition; payload declarations alone are insufficient.
event-producer.next_probe: Trigger the transition named in missing_evidence; capture event tuple, order, multiplicity and before/after state, with an unchanged-state control. Establish unknown timing from native evidence before asserting it.

structure-producer.dependency: A concrete producing or consuming API, populated inputs, and an authoritative field contract. Missing producer identification remains a probe-design blocker.
structure-producer.next_probe: Identify the API in cited evidence; obtain a populated structure, change one relevant input, and observe the exact structure/field named by the row. Compare empty/missing cases separately; do not invent values from field types.

api-state.dependency: Pinned behavioral semantics plus concrete inputs or a backing model; unknown identity, mappings, defaults and coercion need evidence, not placeholders.
api-state.next_probe: Exercise the exact symbol against the missing behavior named in missing_evidence; capture returns and observable before/after state. Identify a producer/consumer and concrete values first. A signature-only row remains probe-design-blocked.

deferred-security.dependency: Security/secret enforcement is excluded from the active scope.
deferred-security.next_probe: Do not execute enforcement work in this phase. Preserve the exact unknown boundary and existing capture references for a separately authorized security investigation.

window-transition.dependency: Observable maximize/restore/fullscreen transitions; dimensions alone cannot identify same-size transitions.
window-transition.next_probe: Capture actual window-state transitions with dimensions and ordered scale events; compare same-size maximize/restore against a no-transition control.

store-population-capture.dependency: A native build/state where the dropdown population entry point exists. Existing capture never invoked it.
store-population-capture.next_probe: Record build and callable entry point, then capture population, reuse, displayed text/check state and callbacks. Keep forbidden/protected enforcement outside this non-secret observation.

region-params.dependency: Pinned consumer of CreateRegionParams and a matching PTR build; declaration alone supplies no invocation.
region-params.next_probe: Locate the constructor accepting CreateRegionParams, then vary the exact named field and observe created-region name, layer, sublevel or template effect. Record unavailable constructor as blocked, not an empty success.

timed-entry.dependency: Matching PTR map API accepting or producing TimedSignalMapEntry; exact key/time semantics remain unproven.
timed-entry.next_probe: Identify the map operation, then capture the named key/time field in a populated entry and its behavior across a real time transition. Do not assign native identity or time units from the declaration.

access-predicate.dependency: The predicate declaration does not establish its runtime access-check boundary; security scope requires separate authorization.
access-predicate.next_probe: Locate the exact annotated API and retain its declaration as evidence. Defer enforcement probing; do not treat the predicate as a callable constructor.
